text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing and controlling threats to a project or business. The first step is identifying risks, which means finding possible problems before they happen. Once risks are known, mitigation strategies can reduce their impact or the chance of them occurring. For example, a company might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to create contingency plans, which are backup plans in case something goes wrong. Finally, monitoring is essential. Risks change over time, so regular reviews help teams notice new dangers and check whether their plans still work. Good risk management does not remove all problems, but it helps people respond calmly and protect their goals.
